name: Starving their infants and selling the milk

verses: Then I saw the souls of those whose own breasts were placed upon a hot frying-pan, by their own hands, and were ever turned from side to side.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by these women, whose souls suffer so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of those women who gave their infants no milk, but emaciated and destroyed them; and for worldly gain, gave milk to the infants of others.
